useCases: Track price cuts in a German city
Get alerts for new listings that match a search

faq.q: Is there an official ImmoScout24 API?
faq.a: Yes, but only for registered partners managing their own listings. This actor reads any immobilienscout24.de search: paste the link and get every listing with price, €/m², size, rooms and address.

faq.q: Can I scrape immobilienscout24.de without code?
faq.a: Yes. Search on immobilienscout24.de with your filters (radius and map searches included), copy the link, paste it and press Start. Download JSON, CSV or Excel.

faq.q: Can it watch for new listings and price cuts?
faq.a: Yes. Monitoring mode compares each run with the previous one and reports new listings, price cuts and removed listings.

faq.q: Can I use it as a ImmoScout24 API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: ImmoScout24 offers its API to registered partners (agents and software vendors) for managing their own listings, not for market data. This actor reads the public search results on immobilienscout24.de.
